measured_readiness.scope: Measured72 calls on five matrices, exact3D final geometry; not an arbitrary-input guarantee.

limits: Repeated timings and saved-history aliases are not independent problems.
Control comparisons cover all public non-timing result, actual state/query and serialized planning fields at float.hex precision.
Failed prefixes never count as full returned-semantic matches or time-to-solution baselines.
Fixed planners do not persist complete policy trees; only their recorded actual expected-count/loss and boundary fields can be audited from raw data.
Adaptive selected depth-three policies persist recursive branch/continuation relationships, which are independently checked.

Exact answers and winners use rational binary-float inputs. Every completed3D confidence/singleton stop is independently recomputed by Fraction polygon clipping over all original candidate winning regions;5D volume values remain internal consistency checks only.
Continuation call time excludes generation of saved initial answers and is never added to the previous failed call to manufacture a fresh full runtime.
